MSTN plays an important role in the maintenance of muscle mass, and its expression decreases in almost all resistance exercise studies. Intriguingly, some research shows correlations between resistance training-induced reductions in MSTN and subsequent increases in muscle growth (222), while other research has failed to demonstrate such associations (66). The specific role of MSTN with respect to its hypertrophic effects during resistance train- ing therefore remains to be fully elucidated. For further insights on the topic, please see the myokine section that covers MSTN in chapter 1.
